local_hard_checks: The returned reward item_id must exist in items.json.
The returned reward count must be a positive integer.
The submitted item_id must exist in items.json.
The player must actually have enough submitted items in player_state.json.
llm_responsibilities: Judge whether the task was completed successfully.
Decide the tone and content of the NPC reply letter.
Decide what rewards are appropriate and why.
Suggest how the world state should change.
Connect current task results to long-term story memory.
recommended_prompt_rule: The LLM may make story and reward decisions freely, but it must only use item_id values that exist in the provided items list.
